NAVAJO COUNTY BOARD OF SUPERVISORS’ MINUTES 
TUESDAY, December 11, 2012 
 
PRESENT: David Tenney, Supervisor; Jesse Thompson, Supervisor; Jerry Brownlow, Vice-Chairman; and 
J.R. DeSpain Chairman were present in person. Jonathan M. Nez, Supervisor was present via video 
conferencing.  
9:00 a.m.  Call To Order: Pledge of Allegiance and Invocation was led by Chairman DeSpain.  
CALL TO THE PUBLIC : Sheriff Clark introduced Jim Molesa, the new Chief Deputy Sheriff . Supervisor 
David Tenney expressed his appreciation to Chairman DeSpain and Vice-Chairman Brownlow for their 
friendship, mentoring, ex ample of hard work and public service . Chairman DeSpain and Vice -Chairman 
Brownlow thanked David for his friendship. Supervisor Thompson spoke of the issues that have faced Navajo 
County and indicated that this Board has done this together. Gail DeCross thanked Chairman DeSpain and 
Vice-Chairman Brownlow from her and her husband Wendell, for their service they have each given.   
CONSENT AGENDA:  a) Minutes: October 23 Regular Meeting, October 31 Special Meeting, November 13 
Regular Meeting, November 20 Special Meeting and November 27 Regular Meeting  b) Clerk of Superior Court 
Report November 2012  c) Justice Court Reports: Holbrook Precinct #1, November; Winslow Precinct #2, 
November; Snowflake Taylor Precinct #3, November; Kayenta Precinct #4, November; Show Low Precinct #5, 
November; and Pinetop -Lakeside Precinct #6, November  d) Juvenile Probation Report November 2012  e) 
Constable Reports: Holbrook Precinct #1, October 2012  f) Appointment to the Navajo County Democratic 
Committee of the following as Precinct Committeemen to fill existing vacancies in their respective precincts: 
Donald N. Wise, K Barbara Teague, Eduardo H Coronado and Derreck  Wheeler g) Rename an existing road in 
the Pinetop-Lakeside area from Palamino Drive to “Palomino Drive” in Section 02, Township 08 North, Range 
23 East  h) Intergovernmental Agreement with the City of Flagstaff for a grant to inventory and assess 
Brownfield properties along Historic Route 66 corridor  i) Public Utility Easement  j) Special Use Permit with 
the Forest Service for Lone Pine Landfill -Maintenance and Monitoring k) Sympathy letter to the family of 
former Gila County Supervisor Ron Christensen l) Warrant & Voucher Report over $1000: September, October 
& November 2012 m) Award Contract to Tate’s Auto Direct for purchase of 2013 Ford Escape in the amount of 
$26,085.39: Supervisor Brownlow made a motion to authorize the Chairman to sign the items in the  consent 
agenda as presented; motion seconded by Supervisor Tenney. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
EMPLOYEE RECOGNITION: Navajo County Recognizes Aaron Ulibarri, Debra Chapman, Delton Jenkins, 
and Melissa Buckley for their excellence in personal performance far exceeding organization expectations : Pam 
Phillips recognized Aaron Ullibarri, Debra Chapman, Delton Jenkins and Melissa Buckley for their excellence 
in personal performance. Mr. Jayne commented on the lunch  he was able to share with each of the employee’s 
recognized today. Chairman DeSpain also commented on the good work done by each employee. 
HUMAN RESOURCES:  
a. Personnel Service Awards : Mr. Jayne introduced Kim Eavenson, the new Human Resources  Director. 
Kim Eavenson recognized Rob Edwards and Marque French both with 10 years of service.  
b. Consideration and possible approval of Personnel Actions : Kim Eavenson reviewed the 21 item 
personnel action report. Supervisor Tenney made a motion to approve the personnel  action report as 
presented; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote unanimous approving the motion.

<!-- page 2 -->
NAVAJO COUNTY PUBLIC HEALTH SERVICES DISTRICT: Board of Directors Session :  
Supervisor Tenney made a motion to enter into the Navajo County Public He alth Services District Board of 
Directors Session; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
a. CONSENT AGENDA:   
i) Renewal of Contract Number ADHS13-034543, the Family Planning/Reproductive Health program 
ii) Professional Services contract with German A. Sierra, DDS, for Dental services through the Dental 
Sealant Program effective January 1, 2013 to December 31, 2013 in the amount of $50.00 per hour 
iii) Professional Services contract with Regina Rich, AP for Dental Hygiene serv ices through the Dental 
Sealant Program effective January 1, 2013 to December 31, 2013 in the amount of $45.00 per hour 
iv) Professional Services contract with Connie Baine, RDH, AP for Dental Hygiene services through the 
Dental Sealant Program effective January 1, 2013 to December 31, 2013 in the amount of $45.00 per 
hour 
v) Professional Services contract with Tina Muldoon, for Dental Assistant services through the Dental 
Sealant Program effective January 1, 2013 to December 31, 2013 in the amount of $14.00 per hour 
Supervisor Tenney made a motion to approve the consent agenda as presented; motion seconded by 
Supervisor Thompson. Vote unanimous approving the motion.   
b. Consideration and possible approval of a Professional Services contract with Kenneth F. Rice, DMD, for 
Dental services through the Dental Sealant Program effective December 1, 2012 to December 31, 2013 
in the amount of $50.00 per hour: Dr. Wade Kartchner discussed the item. Supervisor Thompson made 
a motion to approve the Professional Services contract with Kenneth F. Rice, DMD, for Dental services 
through the Dental Sealant Program effective December 1, 2012 to December 31, 2013 in the amount of 
$50.00 per hour; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
Supervisor Brownlow made a motion to return to regular session; motion seconded by Supervisor Tenney. 
Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
BOARD OF SUPERVISORS:  
a. Consideration and possible recommendation for approval of an Agent Change and Acquisition of 
Control application under license #10093056 by Kayed Jamal for the Overgaard Food Center located at 
2737 Mogollon Drive, Overgaard: Catrina Roe discussed the item. Supervisor Tenney made a motion 
to recommend approval of the  agent change and acquisition of control app lication under license 
#10093056 by Kayed Jamal for the Overgaard Food Center located at 2737 Mogollon Drive, Overgaard; 
motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
b. Consideration and possible recommendation for approval of  a liquor license application under license 
#06090027 by Gary Martinson for the Porter Mountain Steak House located at 4048 Porter Mountain 
Road, Lakeside : Catrina Roe discussed the item. Mr. Gary Martinson addressed the Board  regarding 
Porter Mountain Ste ak House liquor license and thanked the Board for their support. Supervisor 
Tenney made a motion to recommend approval  of the liquor license application under license 
#06090027 by Gary Martinson for the Porter Mountain Steak House located at 4048 Porter Mountain 
Road, Lakeside; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
c. Consideration and possib le approval of the 2013 Navajo County Board of Supervisors’ me eting 
schedule: Melissa Buckley discussed the item. Supervisor Tenney made a motion to approve the 2013 
Navajo County Board of Supervisors’ meeting schedule;  motion seconded by  Supervisor Thompson. 
Vote unanimous approving the motion. 
d. Consideration and possible approval of Ordinance Number 03-12, adopting a county wide fee schedule 
to provide for a standardized cost of copying, electronic media and notary serv ices provided by Navajo 
County: Melis sa Buckley discussed the item  and answered questions of the Board . Mr. Jayne 
commented on the item. Supervisor Tenney made a motion to  approve Ordinance Number 03 -12,

<!-- page 3 -->
adopting a county wide fee schedule to provide for standardized cost of copying, electron ic media and 
notary services provided by Navajo County ; motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson . Vote 
unanimous approving the motion. 
e. BOARD OF EQUALIZATION : Supervisor Tenney made a motion  to enter into Board of 
Equalization; motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson. Vote unanimous  approving the motion . 
Consideration and possible approval of the property owners’ appeal to re -classify property to class three 
properties (owner occupied), waive assessed penalties and liens related to this recent reclassification  
action, and direct the County Assessor to re -classify the properties to class three (owner occupied), 
pursuant to A.R.S. §41 -12003 for the following properties: APN 210 -35-029 and Taxpayer/Account 
#M120004501: Melissa Buckley discussed the item. Supervisor Thompson made a motion to approve 
the property owners’ appeal to re -classify property to class three properties (owner occupied), waive 
assessed penalties and liens related to this recent reclassification action, and direct the County Assessor 
to re -classify the properties to class three (owner occupied), pursuant to A.R.S. §41 -12003 for the 
following properties: APN 210 -35-029 and Taxpayer/Account #M120004501 ; motion seconded by 
Supervisor Tenney. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
f. BOARD OF EQUALIZATI ON: Consideration and possible denial of the property owner's appeal to 
re-classify property which has not satisfied the requirements of occupancy status, and maintain property 
classification at class four properties (non-owner occupied). The class four pr operty classification (non-
owner occupied), shall remain in effect Pursuant to A.R.S. §42 -12052 for the following property: APN 
205-12-002A: Melissa Buckley  discussed the item. Supervisor Tenney made a motion to deny the 
property owner's appeal to re -classify property which has not satisfied the requirements of occupancy 
status, and maintain property classification at class four properties (non -owner occupied). The class four 
property classification (non -owner occupied), shall remain in effect Pursuant to A .R.S. §42-12052 for 
the following property: APN 205 -12-002A; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote 
unanimous approving the motion.  
Supervisor Tenney made a motion to return to regular session; motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson. 
Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS: Consideration and possible approval of an Intergovernmental 
Agreement between the Arizona Supreme Court, the Navajo County School Superintendent and the Navajo 
County Board of Supervisors; for Title I and other associated funds for juvenile detention education services : 
Linda Morrow discussed the item. Supervisor Brownlow made a motion to approve the Intergovernmental 
Agreement between the Arizona Supreme Court, the Navajo County School Supe rintendent and the Navajo 
County Board of Supervisors; for Title I and other associated funds for juvenile detention education services; 
motion seconded by Supervisor Tenney. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
ADMINISTRATION: Consideration and possible award of contract for preconstruction services to FCI 
Constructors in an amount not to exceed $25,830 and a Service Fee in the amount of 6.5% of the project cost 
for the new Jail Facility construction and retrofit : Commander Garcia gave a brief presentatio n on the new jail 
facility. Supervisor Brownlow asked about why the arbitration language is crossed out on the contract. Mary 
Springer indicated that there is substitute language that refers to mediation. Joe Kelleger from FCI discussed the 
mediation process rather than arbitration. Mary Springer discussed the preconstruction services in the amount of 
$25,830. Supervisor Tenney  made a motion  to award contract for preconstruction services to FCI 
Constructors in an amount not to exceed $25,830 and a Service F ee in the amount of 6.5% of the project cost 
for the new Jail Facility construction and retrofit ; motion seconded by Supervisor Brownlow. Vote unanimous 
approving the motion.

<!-- page 4 -->
PUBLIC WORKS:  
a. Consideration and possible award of Contract #B12 -10-017 Supply of Various Roadway Materials to 
Brimhall Sand and Rock and Building Materials, Inc., Dyna Rock and Sand, Inc., Hatch Construction 
and Paving, Inc., and Perkins Cinders, Inc., effective December 28, 2012 : Homero Vela discussed the 
item. Supervisor Thompson  made a motion to award Contract #B12 -10-017 Supply of Various 
Roadway Materials to Brimhall Sand and Rock and Building Materials, Inc., Dyna Rock and Sand, Inc., 
Hatch Construction and Paving, Inc., and Perkins Cinders, Inc., effective December 28, 2012; m otion 
seconded by Supervisor Tenney. Vote unanimous approving the motion.  
b. Consideration and possible award of Contract #B12 -10-030 Purchase of (1) or more conventional 10-
Wheel Tandem Axle Tractors to RWC International, Ltd. In the amount of $141,275.72 : Homero Vela 
discussed the item and indicated that the tractor is new. Supervisor Brownlow made a motion to award 
Contract # B12-10-030 Purchase of (1) or more conventional 10 -Wheel Tandem Axle Tractors to RWC 
International, Ltd. In the amount of $141,275.7 2; motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson. Vote 
unanimous approving the motion.  
c. Consideration and possible approval of the expenditure of $50,000 from District I Special Road Funds to 
be utilized for Navajo County’s personnel and equipment expenses related to the Red Dog Project : 
Homero Vela discussed the item. Supervisor Nez made comments on the item and thanked the Public 
Works Department. Supervisor Nez made a motion to approve  the expenditure of $50,000 from 
District I Special Road Funds to be utilized  for Navajo County’s personnel and equipment expenses 
related to the Red Dog Project; motion seconded by Supervisor Thompson. Vote unanimous approving 
the motion.  
d. Consideration and possible approval of an Intergovernmental Agreement with the Navajo Nation  and 
Navajo County for Road Projects : Homero Vela asked that the item be pulled. Supervisor Thompson 
agreed to continue the item to the January agenda.  
BOARD OF SUPERVISORS:  
a. Presentation of a Plaque of Appreciation for 2012 Service to Chairman J.R. DeSpain: Kerry Ballard and 
Tom Porcharsky made a presentation to Supervisor DeSpain. James Jayne made a presentation to the 
outgoing 2012 Chairman, Supervisor J.R. DeSpain.  
b. Navajo County recognizes Supervisor Jerry Brownlow and Supervisor J.R. DeSpain for  their 
distinguished and dedicated service to their communities and Navajo County : Officials from in and 
around Navajo County recognized Supervisor Brownlow and Supervisor DeSpain.  
COUNTY BUSINESS UPDATE: Report from Board members, County Attorney and Cou nty Manager : 
Supervisor Tenney reported on some of the meetings at the Legislature. Supervisor Thompson reported on 
District II. Supervisor Nez reported on District I . Supervisor Nez, Justice of the Peace Susie Nelson, Court 
Clerk Esther Grass and Doris Cl ark from the Recorders Office  gave a special presentation to Supervisor 
DeSpain and Supervisor Brownlow . Supervisor Brownlow and Supervisor DeSpain thanked Supervisor Nez 
and staff. Supervisor Thompson  introduced Ty from Spider Mound . Supervisor Brownlow gave a final report 
from District V. Supervisor DeSpain gave a final report from District III and further reported on CSA events.   
ADJOURN:  At 11:13 a.m. Supervisor Tenney made a motion to adjourn; motion seconded by Supervisor 
Thompson. Vote unanimous approving the motion.
